inputs.original_text:
Folks, look at what’s happening in the South Portland School District right now. They are facing a massive budget shortfall that is forcing them to slash more than 70 positions from our schools. This is a complete failure of basic stewardship, and once again, our children and our hard-earned tax dollars are paying the price.

As one local parent and taxpayer rightly put it, it is beyond maddening. For years, we’ve watched bloated bureaucracies and progressive mismanagement prioritize everything except the fundamentals—teaching the basics, respecting parents, and maintaining fiscal sanity. When the people running these institutions can't even balance a budget, they are failing the most basic test of authority and responsibility. 

Instead of focusing on core education and traditional values that build strong communities, these systems crumble under their own weight, leaving families to pick up the pieces. If we don't demand accountability and return to local, sensible stewardship, our children's future will continue to be sacrificed on the altar of administrative waste.
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, we are witnessing yet another manufactured crisis in the South Portland School District, where a massive budget shortfall is now threatening our community by slashing more than 70 positions from our schools. Make no mistake: this isn't about fiscal sanity or traditional values; it’s about a system that chronically underfunds our public institutions and leaves vulnerable educators, workers, and students to pay the price for systemic inequality. 

While certain voices try to scapegoat administrative priorities, the reality is that working families and school staff are the ones being sacrificed. When institutions crumble under their own weight, it exposes the deep structural failures of how we value labor and education in our communities. Instead of protecting the workers who educate our children, the establishment lets our schools starve. We need deep institutional reform and true accountability that centers the needs of working people and our children, rather than letting the powerful dismantle our public goods.
